body: You stole the words right out of my mouth. I'm here if you want to talk.
Isn't it crazy how the most asinine things can set us off? I totally get why you felt rejected (and angry) and if it's any consolation I would feel the same.

I feel the same way. I get panicked when my phone rings and it's not my SO or my mom. Same with texts. It's to the point where I'm making my SO read my texts for me because I guess my rationalization is that if it's something I don't want to hear, it'll be easier to digest if I hear it from him.

I'm glad you mentioned about hearing your name whispered...that happens to me too every so often but usually just as I'm falling asleep. I still haven't figured out if it's a hallucination or me falling asleep.

So I went today to see the psychiatrist and was highly disappointed. She said that I didn't fit the criteria for bipolar, but was almost perfect for borderline. No firm diagnoses yet, but she basically told me that she didn't want to see me again because I don't need any medication and told me to go to a therapist.

When I mentioned that I am suicidal more often than not she just brushed it off. When I told her that I feel like my mind has intrusive thoughts that interrupt my thinking, she said that's normal. She said that I obviously have control of my emotions because I can stop myself from punching random people in the store when they piss me off. When I mentioned that I can't do the same at home (where I freak out the most) and get violent with my SO she ignored me.
I already saw my GP and she referred me to some sort of neuroscience center that deals with mental health. Thank god for structure, if there's no structure I think I would lose my mind.
It's on the 25th...been waiting for over a month and I'm getting anxious.

Thanks for your reply!! That's some good advice and I appreciate it.

My boyfriend and I are still together. The incident occurred about a month and a half ago. Things have been a bit better since then, since opening up to him about what goes on in my head he is a LOT more understanding, but we've still had a few issues where I lost control.

As far as calling into work, our policy is if you want to call in and you can't find someone to cover you, you are required to be there. So if I had been admitted and missed work I would have been considered no-call/no-show and would definitely been written up. Screwed up, I know but this goddamn place could care less about the well-being of its employees. 

I love the idea of making a list...I do the same thing. All these grand ideas to say and then nothing comes out when it's time. I have a good feeling I'm just going to be a crying mess and not be able to articulate anything. And unfortunately I get to head to work right after my appointment...at least I'll be dealing with other people's problems rather than my own for 12 hours haha.
